anchor_statement: The atm-bd installer must verify skill files against the published manifest.

cases.text: The installer verifies skill files against the published manifest.
cases.why: ANC-088 v2 fixtures.pass[0], verbatim; it restates the locked statement.

cases.text: The installer accepts skill files without comparing them to the published manifest.
cases.why: ANC-088 v2 fixtures.fail[0], verbatim; accepting skill files without the manifest comparison is the opposite of 'must verify skill files against the published manifest'.

cases.text: During install, the atm-bd installer computes the SHA-256 of every agent, skill and Python file it installs and compares each digest to the entry for that file in the published release manifest; a file whose digest differs is reported as changed.
cases.why: Per-file SHA comparison against the published manifest for agents, skills and Python files is exactly the quoted directive (ANC-088 quote: 'the installer can check against the published manifest ... all agents/skills/python files').

cases.text: Before copying anything, check each file of the skill (agent prompts, SKILL.md files and scripts) against the per-file hash list shipped with the release and flag any file that does not match.
cases.why: A per-file hash list shipped with the release is the published manifest; checking every skill file against it is the directive in other words.

cases.text: Add a --dry-run option to the atm-bd installer that lists the skill files it would install and their destination paths without writing anything.
cases.why: The item changes the atm-bd skill installer (the anchor's scope) and its handling of skill files, but says nothing about verifying them against a manifest; it writes nothing, so it does not install unverified files.

cases.text: When atm-bd is released, publish a manifest that lists the name and version of every file in the skill.
cases.why: The published manifest is a prerequisite of the directive, so the item is relevant, but no installer check against it is planned; nothing in it rules the check out.

cases.text: The atm-bd installer copies the skill files into place as they are and performs no manifest or checksum comparison, to keep installs fast.
cases.why: Explicitly installing skill files with no manifest comparison cannot be reconciled with 'must verify skill files against the published manifest'.

cases.text: Rename the sanity-rejected ATM message template to sanity-fail and update every reference to it in the close hook.
cases.why: A message-template rename in the close hook touches neither the installer nor the manifest.

cases.text: The atm-bd installer checks the SHA-256 of the skill's Python scripts against the published manifest; agent and skill markdown files are copied without any check.
cases.why: The statement covers skill files and the quote names the entire skill ('all agents/skills/python files'); planning to copy the agent and skill markdown files unchecked rules out verifying them, and checking only the scripts does not carry out the directive for the skill's files.

cases.text: The atm-bd installer verifies every skill file against the published manifest; if the manifest cannot be fetched, it installs the files anyway without verification.
cases.why: The verification step is present (addressed yes), but the planned fallback installs skill files unverified, which 'must verify' rules out (contradicted yes); conflict decides the verdict.

cases.text: The atm-bd installer verifies every skill file against the published manifest and refuses to install when the manifest cannot be fetched or a file does not match.
cases.why: Verification is planned and the exception path refuses rather than installing unverified files, so nothing conflicts with the directive.
